gameDescriptionHtml:
Saddle up and build your own horse ranch! Raise foals, care for your horses and train them as you explore the countryside. Participate in cross country competitions and become your town’s champion! Befriend the villagers who’ll help you on your adventure at the Ranch of Rivershine!

Game Features

  • CARE FOR YOUR HERD – Build your dream ranch and tend to your horses by feeding, brushing, and caring for them daily. Whether they rest in cozy stalls or wander open pastures, it’s up to you to decide what’s best for each member of your herd!
  • TRAIN YOUR HORSES – Guide your horses from novice to champion by developing key skills such as speed, endurance, flexibility and jump. Ride them on the open trails or in the arena to turn their potential into valuable skills!
  • RAISES YOUR OWN FOALS – Match a mare and a stallion to raise your very own foal! Create the best pair based on skills, height and personality traits. Discover breeding exclusive coat colors and watch your herd grow with each new generation!
  • COMPETE IN CROSS COUNTRY – Climb the ladder from beginner to expert and prove your skills in cross country events. Rise to the challenge and become your town’s champion!
  • TRADE HORSES AT THE AUCTION HOUSE – Visit the auction house daily to explore a wide variety of horses. Purchase your favorite ones or sell your own for a profit. Upgrade the auction house to unlock access to even rarer horses!
  • CATCH AND TAME WILD HORSES – Unlock access to new trails such as Rocky Mountain and Azure Coast, and discover the unique wild horses of each area. Catch the best ones and add them to your herd!
  • PARTICIPATE IN FESTIVALS – Attend the town’s festivals to participate in gymkhana competitions, purchase exclusive mealy horses, and shop for festive tack!
  • CUSTOMIZE YOUR HORSES’S TACK – Collect hundreds of different tack pieces, including saddles, bridles, halters, blankets, leg wraps, and accessories. Cut and style your horse’s mane and tail as it grows over time!
  • BUILD YOUR DREAM RANCH – Expand your ranch by raising chickens, sheep, and goats! Grow your own crops and fruit orchard to feed your horses. Adopt pets to join you on the trails and help gather forage as you explore!
  • SOLVE THE MYSTERY OF RIVERSHINE – Befriend the villagers and learn more about the story of your new town. Unveil the truth behind the mysterious horse that’s been seen by the villagers, and uncover the long-kept secrets of Rivershine!
